latest.title: Como minha trajetória mudou em poucas semanas (e o papel do AWS Builder Center nisso)
latest.description: Mudanças recentes na minha trajetória me levaram a explorar a área de arquitetura ao mesmo tempo em que iniciei no AWS Builder Center. Vamos ver onde isso vai dar?

latest.title: AI Coaching Notes + Video Sync with AWS (PlayTicks)
latest.description: PlayTicks is a real-time soccer coaching annotation tool that converts short voice notes into structured match events. Built with Amazon S3, AWS Lambda, Amazon Transcribe, Amazon Bedrock, and Amazon ECS, it automatically transcribes and classifies coaching notes and syncs them to game timestamps for faster post-game video review.

latest.title: Minha primeira aplicação na nuvem: o que aprendi hospedando um sistema real na AWS
latest.description: Construir um sistema na faculdade é uma coisa. Colocar um sistema real no ar, com usuários de verdade, é outra bem diferente. Neste artigo, compartilho os desafios, erros e aprendizados que tive ao hospedar minha primeira aplicação na AWS — um sistema de gestão para clínicas de estética. Das dores de configuração ao medo da fatura no fim do mês, passando pelo papel da IA como aliada nos momentos de travamento. Um relato sincero sobre o que a faculdade não ensina, mas a prática entrega.

latest.title: From Campus to Community: AWS Cloud Club at UH at AWS Community on Tour Houston
latest.description: The AWS Cloud Club at the University of Houston attended the AWS Community Day on Tour Houston stop and walked away with hands-on Kiro experience, a new mental model for building with AI, and real connections in the AWS community.

latest.title: 🚀 Elevating the Standard: From ASCII Diagrams to Visual Architectures with Kiro 101 and AWS MCP
latest.description: In the world of Cloud Engineering, precision is paramount. Recently, I migrated to a high-performance, cost-optimized environment under strict resource monitoring, which has enabled greater agility in my operations. After installing the Kiro IDE and CLI on Ubuntu, I consolidated what I consider a "one possible professional workflow" applicable to cloud architecture

latest.title: Building Intelligence with AWS
latest.description: This is how I built the ACCIPITER: ALTUM branch in AWS AI Playground, and how AWS helped me push the frontiers of code.

latest.title: Build a Live Streaming Application With Amazon IVS and Stream Chat
latest.description: Learn how to combine Amazon IVS low-latency and real-time streaming with Stream Chat to build a production-ready app featuring live video playback and interactive chat

latest.title: Como funciona um site na internet
latest.description: Você já parou pra pensar no que acontece entre digitar um endereço no navegador e ver a página carregada na sua tela? Como algo que pode ter sido criado em qualquer lugar no mundo chega tão rápido até a gente? Nesse artigo, vamos desvendar juntos o caminho que um site percorre até chegar até você.

latest.title: Kodai Kondattam: How Madurai Hosted One of India's Most Memorable Tech Meetups
latest.description: A fantastic summer tech meetup that featured sessions on Generative AI, a live demo by an Agentic AI-powered robot as the world's first non-human chief guest, and a creative AI storytelling session. A brilliant example of how strong communities can bring cutting-edge technology to any city!

latest.title: Automate IAM Access keys lifecycle with Human-in-the-loop
latest.description: Learn how to migrate away from static unused AWS IAM access keys using a three-phase approach- discover, deactivate and delete- with IAM Access Analyzer and Step Functions. This solution also includes a human-in-the-loop approval step before permanent deletion.

trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: NeuroVoice
trending.description: Small moments, repeated daily, reveal what single snapshots never can - patterns that quietly signal neurological risk. NeuroVoice is a multimodal Parkinson’s screening platform that tracks pattern over time to detect subtle neurological changes early.

trending.title: Como começar na AWS de graça: um guia prático para estudantes
trending.description: Neste guia prático para estudantes, você vai aprender passo a passo como criar sua conta gratuita na AWS, quais serviços pode usar sem gastar um centavo, e o que fazer nos primeiros 30 minutos para sair do zero com segurança. Inclui um mapa mental para organizar seus estudos e um roteiro de 4 semanas para evoluir do absoluto iniciante ao primeiro projeto real rodando na nuvem.

trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: ASET – Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth
trending.description: ASET (Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth) is an AI-powered claim verification platform built on AWS that verifies scientific claims against 1.2M+ peer-reviewed papers across 8 domains — and automatically fetches and permanently stores new papers from arXiv, PubMed, etc. when gaps are found, making the knowledge base self-growing with every query. From typed claims to YouTube videos and uploaded documents, ASET delivers evidence-backed trust scores in under 10 seconds.

trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: Global Impact AI Navigator
trending.description: Global Impact AI Navigator (GIAN) is a multi-agent AI platform built on Amazon Bedrock that transforms a raw idea into a complete strategic package in under 60 seconds — SWOT diagnostic, live-grounded funding discovery, personalized roadmap, and a context-aware advisor. Designed for innovators in emerging markets, it democratizes access to the strategic guidance that usually requires expensive consultants or elite networks.
